title: Retire the one-time .bot-state.json import that runs on every database load

options.name: Keep the import on every load
options.risk: A stale .bot-state.json next to an empty database is imported as open buys and renamed (AUD-DB-019).

options.name: Delete migrateJsonState
options.behavior_impact: Legacy JSON state is never imported again.
options.risk: An operator with a pre-Phase-4 state file loses the automatic import (none is expected; the repo-root .bak shows it already ran).

options.name: Move it into npm run db:init behind an explicit flag

recommendation: remove: the import already ran (the .bak file exists) and the code path only adds risk.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract); no capital effect.
behavior_impact: Decides whether loading the database can import an old JSON state file.
